metadata.title: Code Sentinel
metadata.summary: A review environment that turns repository context into precise, traceable engineering feedback.

narrative.problem: Code review signals were fragmented across tools, leaving teams to reconstruct context by hand.
narrative.constraints: Repository-scale context, strict data boundaries, and explainable AI output.
narrative.decision: A retrieval layer assembles scoped code context before specialized review agents evaluate each change.
narrative.result: A coherent review workflow with transparent sources and repeatable engineering decisions.

metadata.title: Facility Importer
metadata.summary: A resilient import workflow for validating and reconciling complex operational datasets.

narrative.problem: Large facility imports failed opaquely and required expensive manual reconciliation.
narrative.constraints: Inconsistent source schemas, partial failures, and long-running background operations.
narrative.decision: A staged, idempotent pipeline separates parsing, validation, review, and commit.
narrative.result: Operators can understand failures, correct source data, and safely resume an import.

paragraphs: Large facility imports failed opaquely and required expensive manual reconciliation.
Inconsistent source schemas, partial failures, and long-running background operations.
A staged, idempotent pipeline separates parsing, validation, review, and commit.

metadata.title: Northstar
metadata.summary: A technical control surface for understanding events moving through distributed services.

narrative.problem: Operational events were technically available but difficult to connect into a system narrative.
narrative.constraints: High event volume, asynchronous services, and multiple ownership boundaries.
narrative.decision: A normalized event model and streaming gateway power a focused investigation interface.
narrative.result: Teams gain a shared, navigable view of service behavior without masking system complexity.

paragraphs: Northstar gives an on-call engineer one navigable timeline of how an event actually moved through the system, instead of four separate dashboards that each show a fragment of it.
Built as an independent systems project after repeatedly reconstructing incidents by hand from scattered logs, metrics and traces across service boundaries.
Sole designer and engineer: event model, streaming gateway, and the investigation interface.

constraints.title: High volume, low latency
paragraphs: Event throughput rules out querying each service on demand; the gateway keeps a normalized, queryable copy of event state without becoming a second system of record.

constraints.title: No single owner
paragraphs: Services are owned by different teams with inconsistent event shapes, so the model has to tolerate partial, inconsistent input rather than assume a clean schema.
A gRPC gateway ingests events from Go services, normalizes them onto one schema, and publishes them to Kafka; a React investigation UI queries the resulting event store directly.

technicalDecisions.title: One normalized event model instead of per-service schemas

paragraphs: Every event is mapped to a single normalized envelope (actor, subject, action, timestamp, correlation id) before it reaches storage or the UI.
An investigation view that has to understand many service-specific schemas doesn't scale past a handful of services; normalizing at the gateway keeps that complexity in one place.

alternatives.approach: Query each service's native event format directly from the UI
alternatives.tradeOff: Pushes schema knowledge into the UI and breaks every time a service changes its event shape.

paragraphs: The gateway runs a per-service adapter that maps native fields onto the normalized envelope before publishing to Kafka.

technicalDecisions.title: A streaming gateway between services and the event store

paragraphs: Go services publish to the gateway over gRPC rather than writing to Kafka or the event store directly.
Centralizing ingestion lets normalization, backpressure and retry logic live in one place instead of being reimplemented by every service team.

result.note: No production load test has been run; the throughput figure below is from local benchmarking only.

paragraphs: The gateway and ingestion services are Go, communicating over gRPC; Kafka holds the normalized event stream, and a Go consumer writes it into the queryable event store the React UI reads from.

learnings.title: Normalize early
paragraphs: Pushing normalization to the edge of the system, right at ingestion, made every downstream consumer simpler.

learnings.title: Design for partial data
paragraphs: Treating incomplete or malformed events as a normal case, rather than an error, avoided a brittle pipeline.
A working pipeline from service event to investigation UI, with a normalized event model that has absorbed three different service teams' event shapes without a UI change.

metadata.title: VC Brain
metadata.summary: A research workspace that connects company knowledge, market context, and sourced analysis.

narrative.problem: Research lived across documents and personal notes, making evidence hard to retrieve.
narrative.constraints: Mixed document formats, access control, and the need for source-grounded answers.
narrative.decision: Hybrid retrieval combines structured company data with semantically indexed documents.
narrative.result: Research becomes reusable and every generated synthesis remains connected to evidence.
